text: Carpentry is the skilled craft of creating structures from wood, involving the use of hand tools and traditional techniques. A key element in carpentry is varnish, which protects wood from moisture and wear, enhancing its durability and appearance. Varnish applied to the wood makes it stronger and more resilient. Carpenters also focus on joints, as these connections between pieces of wood are crucial for a strong and functional structure. Skilled carpenters meticulously select and fit joints to create a solid and aesthetically pleasing end product.
